summary: Frontend-only verification of the new stacked Menu page with sticky scrollspy nav and Tacos Builder card. All 7 acceptance criteria PASS. Nav renders with data-testid=menu-cat-nav sticky under header; 9 sections render in the exact expected order (signatures, classiques, smash-burgers, wraps, sandwiches, sides, kids, desserts, drinks) each with an <h2> and >0 MenuItemCards. Item counts observed: signatures=8+1 tacos, classiques=6, smash-burgers=3, wraps=3, sandwiches=5, sides=7, kids=1, desserts=3, drinks=4. Initial active chip = cat-signatures. Scrollspy correctly switches active chip to cat-wraps, cat-drinks, and back to cat-signatures. Clicking cat-desserts immediately adds 'active' class and section-desserts scrolls into viewport (getBoundingClientRect().top=225 within 0-300). Tacos Builder card renders as first grid child of section-signatures with unsplash image, 'Nouveau' + 'Sur mesure' badges, description, and open-burger-builder button; clicking it opens burger-builder-modal. Old build-burger-cta banner is gone (count=0). No cat-all or cat-burgers chips exist. ScrollToTop still fires when navigating into /menu (window.scrollY=0). No regressions detected.

issues: 'no-scrollbar' class used on chip strip is not defined as a Tailwind utility in the config; native scrollbar may show on mobile. Cosmetic only, not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: Menu.jsx IntersectionObserver rootMargin '-40% 0px -40% 0px' works well; consider adding threshold hysteresis if users report chip flicker between two adjacent sections at midpoint.

TacosBuilderCard: source string 'Compose ton Tacos' is CSS-uppercased via .uppercase — fine, but be aware inner_text() reads 'COMPOSE TON TACOS' in tests; use case-insensitive assertions in future tests.
BurgerBuilderModal lacks a data-testid=builder-close on its close button (Escape works). Consider adding for testability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Menu page (/menu) now uses vertical stacked sections with sticky scrollspy nav. All 9 categories render with data-testid=section-<slug>, chips with data-testid=cat-<slug>. Tacos Builder is a normal MenuItemCard-shaped card at data-testid=menu-item-tacos-builder placed as first child of section-signatures grid. Clicking data-testid=open-burger-builder opens data-testid=burger-builder-modal. Add data-testid=builder-close in the future for cleaner close testing.
